After: cookie gone; tea gone; water gone (not counted). About 70% of the fruit eaten (~140g, ~50 kcal). Roughly half the wrap remains, including leftover tortilla and chicken pieces, so ~125g eaten (~225 kcal).

Total: 225 + 120 + 50 + 40 = 435 kcal; 125 + 25 + 140 + 250 = 540 g.
